text: Close-up, low-angle view of a black plastic tube rack occupying the foreground, resting on a pale bench or instrument surface. The rack has rows of square openings; most slots appear empty. In the right-hand section, one upright conical tube stands in a slot, holding a red/pink liquid and closed with an orange screw cap. Behind the rack rise vertical grey and silver metal columns of a larger instrument, with a black cable running down at the left. In the background: a white ceiling with lit fluorescent light fixtures, a dome camera, white walls, a framed white panel, a monitor at left showing a blue screen, and dark equipment on a bench.
